text: The paper has two AI systems debate opposing sides of controversial factuality claims on COVID-19 and climate change, where people hold strong prior beliefs, comparing debate with single-advisor consultancy for human judges with mainstream or skeptical beliefs (Study I) and for AI judges with and without personas (Study II). It reports that in Study I debate improves human accuracy and confidence calibration, outperforming consultancy by 4-10% across the two domains, most for mainstream-belief judges (up to +15.2% accuracy on COVID-19), while also helping skeptical judges who initially misjudge claims move toward accurate views (+4.7% accuracy).
title: AI debate helps human judges with strong prior beliefs assess controversial COVID-19 and climate claims
